en: Animals have different numbers of legs. Let's count them!
A chicken has 2 legs. People have 2 legs too.
A cat has 4 legs. So do goats and buffaloes.
An ant has 6 legs. Every insect has 6 legs.
A spider has 8 legs. That is why a spider is not an insect!
A snake has no legs at all. It slides along on its belly.
id: Hewan punya jumlah kaki yang berbeda-beda. Ayo kita hitung!
Ayam punya 2 kaki. Manusia juga punya 2 kaki.
Kucing punya 4 kaki. Begitu juga kambing dan kerbau.
Semut punya 6 kaki. Semua serangga punya 6 kaki.
Laba-laba punya 8 kaki. Itulah sebabnya laba-laba bukan serangga!
Ular tidak punya kaki sama sekali. Ia meluncur dengan perutnya.

objectives.en: Reads a short information text and recalls facts about animal legs.
objectives.id: Membaca teks informasi pendek dan mengingat fakta tentang kaki hewan.

objectives.en: Uses addition to count legs on more than one animal.
objectives.id: Memakai penjumlahan untuk menghitung kaki lebih dari satu hewan.

meaning.en: a small animal with 8 legs that spins webs
meaning.id: hewan kecil berkaki 8 yang membuat jaring

meaning.en: the front, lower part of the body

prompt.en: How many legs does an ant have?
Why is a spider not an insect?
Two cats are sleeping in the sun. How many legs do they have altogether?
prompt.id: Dua ekor kucing tidur berjemur. Berapa jumlah kaki mereka semuanya?

prompt.en: A chicken stands next to a goat. How many legs are there in all?
prompt.id: Seekor ayam berdiri di samping kambing. Berapa jumlah kaki semuanya?

connection.en: Counting legs is one way scientists sort animals into groups.
connection.id: Menghitung kaki adalah salah satu cara ilmuwan mengelompokkan hewan.

connection.en: Adding the legs of several animals practises addition.
connection.id: Menjumlahkan kaki beberapa hewan melatih penjumlahan.

discussionPrompts.en: Which animal in our house or garden has the most legs?
discussionPrompts.id: Hewan apa di rumah atau kebun kita yang kakinya paling banyak?

discussionPrompts.en: Can you think of another animal with no legs?
discussionPrompts.id: Bisakah kamu menyebut hewan lain yang tidak berkaki?

offlineActivity.en: Go on a leg hunt in the garden or in a picture book. Draw each animal you find and write how many legs it has. Make a tally: 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8 legs. Look at spiders and ants without touching.
offlineActivity.id: Lakukan perburuan kaki di kebun atau di buku bergambar. Gambar setiap hewan yang kamu temukan dan tulis berapa kakinya. Buat turus: 0, 2, 4, 6, atau 8 kaki. Amati laba-laba dan semut tanpa menyentuhnya.

factChecks.claim: Spiders have 8 legs and are not insects.
Chickens have 2 legs; cats, goats and buffaloes have 4; snakes have none.

safetyNotes.en: Some ants bite and some spiders can bite: look closely, but do not touch.
safetyNotes.id: Beberapa semut dan laba-laba bisa menggigit: amati dari dekat, tetapi jangan disentuh.
